pure-announcement.rationale: A position statement documenting a governance event, not a product launch.

duplicate.rationale: No model-governance concept exists in this corpus.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Primary source from the affected party; the directive, timeline and cited policies are stated on the record.

durability.rationale: A primary record of a precedent-setting action — an export-control directive suspending a deployed frontier model — plus conceptual distinctions that transfer: universal versus non-universal jailbreaks, defense-in-depth as the stated alternative to perfect jailbreak resistance, and the argued standard for government deployment-blocking.

actionability.rationale: Nothing to apply; it informs governance reasoning rather than practice.

atomicity.rationale: One event and the position taken on it.
